post.description:
Replace two or more snippets on this canvas with one merged snippet (see
docs/features/merge_blocks.md). ``deleted_ids`` are the originals taken off this canvas; one
also placed on other canvases stays there unchanged with its recordings.

Place snippets of this canvas on ``target_canvas_id`` (same position and size, stacked on
top, ungrouped); ``move`` also removes them from this canvas. All or nothing.

delete.description: Take the snippet off this canvas; when that was its last canvas it is deleted for good.

post.description:
t-SNE positions for the snippets placed on the canvas. A preview: the clients show them
and restore the saved layout on exit, so nothing is written (layout saves go through PUT and
batch-position with this canvas_id).

post.description:
Add a batch. One invalid word rejects it (``invalid_word`` + ``index``); words already in the
bank (ignoring case) come back in ``existing``; ``tag_ids`` are linked to all of them.
Ids that are not the user's (or not ids at all) are ignored.
The filtered bank grouped into rhyme families (at most 1000 words).

get.description:
Dictionary words related in meaning to ``q`` (a word, phrase or theme). 503
``related_words_warming`` (with Retry-After) while the index is built, 503
``related_words_unavailable`` when the embedding model cannot be loaded.

post.description: Bank words (matching ``tag_filter``) ranked against one word of the bank or a typed text.

Link or unlink one tag on many words; idempotent. Any word that is not the user's is a 404
and nothing changes.
